def extract_mcq_answer(text, valid_choices):
    """Extract MCQ answer letter from generated text (for Instruct models)."""
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        return None
    if text[0] in valid_choices:
        return text[0]
    match = re.search(r'(?:answer|Answer)\s*(?:is|:)\s*\**\s*([A-Z])', text)
    if match and match.group(1) in valid_choices:
        return match.group(1)
    match = re.search(r'\(?([A-Z])\)', text)
    if match and match.group(1) in valid_choices:
        return match.group(1)
    for ch in text:
        if ch in valid_choices:
            return ch
    return None


def extract_code_from_markdown(text):
    """Extract code from markdown code blocks (for Instruct model output)."""
    match = re.search(r'```(?:python)?\n(.*?)```', text, re.DOTALL)
    if match:
        return match.group(1)
    return text
